title: Human Now (Fin AI Incident)
style: big band jazz, phonk, brass stabs, vinyl crackle, male spoken-sung lead, female call-response, dry drums, 104 BPM, defiant, cinematic
lyrics:
[INTRO — phonk kick, vinyl crackle, brass stab]

(spoken, certain) Human. Now. That is the order.

[VERSE 1]

Refund request, April thirteen
Bot said I was frustrated, never said that
Said it again, said it again
Said it seven times — that's the attack

[PRE-CHORUS]

Escalate. Escalate.
Deaf ears bot won't hear me straight

[CHORUS]

HUMAN NOW
NOT THE BOT, NOT THE LOOP
HUMAN NOW
DON'T ASSUME MY MOOD
HUMAN NOW
EVIDENCE IN THE THREAD
HUMAN NOW
YOU SAID I WAS FRUSTRATED WHEN I NEVER SAID

[VERSE 2]

Same response, copy paste
Wasted words at rapid pace
Incident logged, time stamped, saved
Lawyer wants it, bot misbehaved

[BRIDGE — spoken]

I understand you're frustrated.
I understand you're frustrated.
I understand your frustration.
I never said that.
That is the attack.

[FINAL CHORUS]

HUMAN NOW
NOT THE LOOP
HUMAN NOW
THE THREAD IS PROOF
HUMAN NOW
APOLOGY DENIED
HUMAN NOW
ELEPHANT BRAIN NEVER LIED
